research_insights: Audience responds strongly to age-specific targeting (60+, 70+)
Printable format reduces friction vs app downloads
Date-specific challenge start creates urgency and community feeling
Anti-running messaging ('F*ck Running') resonates as pattern interrupt
Chair Tai Chi opens up audience who feel they can't stand long
Mind-body connection angle differentiates from typical fitness ads
Longevity angle ('live to 100', 'stay active at any age') performs well
Specific numbers ('7 minutes', '23 pounds', '28 days') increase credibility
UGC-style 'I am [age]' hooks create immediate identification
